description: This file defines the MockUserRoleManager class used in PHPUnit testing for the OrangeHRM project. It extends AbstractUserRoleManager and provides stub implementations for methods related to user role and permission management, all of which throw exceptions if called.

classes.name: MockUserRoleManager
classes.description: A mock implementation of AbstractUserRoleManager intended for unit testing, with methods that throw exceptions to indicate they should be mocked or stubbed in tests.
